mentions.name: Borrow This And Improve It
mentions.description: This app tracks repair histories for physical items, currently bicycles with plans to extend to things like leaf blowers and electronics, and supports giving away half-broken or repaired items together with their repair history — e.g. a bicycle rescued from the trash and fixed up for under $6, paired with a QR code linking to its repair log — so that knowing how something was fixed once makes it more likely it will be fixed again.
mentions.problem: The idea being that knowing how something was fixed once will make it more likely that it would be fixed again.
mentions.source_excerpt: Borrow This And Improve It - an app for tracking repairs to a thing (right now it's bicycles only, planning to extend to other things like leaf blowers and electronics) and giving away half broken things or repaired things to others but with the advantage of also giving away the repair history for something.
